getToKando.heading: Bear Cave BJJ Knox - Getting to Our Boronia Academy from Wantirna
description: Bear Cave BJJ Knox proudly operates within Kando Martial Arts Knox, where shared values and a strong sense of community make it the perfect home for our team. Wantirna families looking for authentic Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu instruction often choose our academy because we focus on building strong foundations in both technique and character.

We believe that good people create great training—and an even better community. That's why we've partnered with the Kando Martial Arts family, whose culture and approach align closely with our own. Together, we work to provide an engaging, complementary, and well-rounded training environment for all members, whether you're here to learn, grow, or push your boundaries.

The journey from Wantirna to our Boronia academy typically takes around 10 to 15 minutes by car. Take Mountain Highway heading west toward Boronia, then turn onto Boronia Road. From Boronia Road, turn into Lewis Road, followed by a turn into Wadhurst Drive. Our facility is located at Unit 2/5 Wadhurst Drive, Boronia.

Wantirna students benefit from our accessible location, making it easy to maintain regular BJJ training schedules. The short commute means families can consistently attend classes, participate in belt promotions, and engage with our Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu community without the challenge of long travel times, helping students progress steadily through their BJJ journey.
